title: Extract StoreInterface & Refactor MemoryStore and Handlers
description: Create internal/store/interface.go defining StoreInterface (and MemoryStore alias/constructor), add atomic ApplyTransition and SaveArena methods, and refactor Server and all handlers in internal/handlers/* to depend on store.StoreInterface with zero regressions.

All handlers in internal/handlers/* compile and use StoreInterface
go test -v -race ./... passes 100% with zero regressions
